description: One private winery's figures against the listed wine companies VINCAP tracks: growth, net margin and size percentiles, and the value range listed price/sales and price/earnings multiples and recorded private-deal EBITDA multiples imply — the same computation as https://vincap.co/benchmark. revenue, profit, ebitda, land_value and inventory are in `currency` (USD or EUR); growth is %. Inputs are used for this answer only and never stored. A range from recorded multiples, not an appraisal. Example: {"revenue":5000000,"profit":400000,"currency":"EUR"}

country.description: the winery's country (as the page lists them)

growth.description: revenue growth on the year before, %

inventory.description: wine in stock at cost, in `currency`

land_value.description: your own estimate of the land's value, in `currency`

profit.description: last full-year net profit (may be negative)

name: benchmark_winery
title: VinCap Benchmark — what's my winery worth?
